description: Platform skills to invoke at each lifecycle stage. WEAVE references these; the agent invokes them. No new skill files are required for this registry — the named skills are platform skills already installed in the operating environment. Read by the lifecycle runner, which emits a stage's skills as a SUGGESTED SKILLS section in the stage prompt. Keys match STAGE_ORDER in runner/lifecycle-runner.mjs, with one exception: 'pre-intent' is not a lifecycle stage — it is a guided-mode-only phase consumed by the runner's pre-intent gate, which runs weave-guided-intake before the intent stage. A stage with no key here simply gets no SUGGESTED SKILLS section; the runner tolerates the gap rather than failing.
